title: Billing display shows correct amount independent of storage format
gherkin:
Given a customer has purchased items totaling $150.00
When the billing display is rendered
Then the displayed amount should be $150.00
And the storage format should not affect the displayed value
rationale: Verifies that billing display logic is separated from underlying storage implementation, ensuring display accuracy is independent of how data is stored.
generationSummary: Test cases for billing display vs storage separation requirement. These tests verify that billing information is properly separated from storage mechanisms, ensuring that display logic is independent from data persistence and that billing calculations are accurate regardless of storage implementation.
